name: Ghaith Audi
tagline: I design the data model, the API and the server it runs on, then build the interface on top. Nine systems so far for clients in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Syria, from a 680-table legacy Oracle schema to a TCP server that reads GPS hardware byte by byte.
availability: Open to remote roles and relocation
portraitAlt: Portrait of Ghaith Audi in a navy suit and tie

work.title: Selected work
work.lead: Nine systems I designed and built. Six are live on the public internet; three run as private deployments on client infrastructure.

approach.title: How I build software
approach.lead: The same five steps on every system, from a clinic app to a pension engine.

steps.title: Understand
steps.example: Days on site with a pensions department before the first data model.

steps.title: Architect
steps.body: Design maintainable systems and clear boundaries.
steps.example: One storage interface let OVACS move files to Google Drive without a migration.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.body: Make systems reliable and observable in production.
steps.example: Four sites on one VPS, each with its own process and database.

steps.title: Improve
steps.body: Iterate based on real usage and feedback.
steps.example: SEO and analytics proven on the Saudi site first, then shipped to the flagship.

experience.title: Experience
experience.lead: Most of it without a senior engineer to hand the hard parts to.

bullets: Continue developing OVACS for its founder: Google Drive storage, subscriptions, and full Arabic right-to-left support.
Build and maintain four sites on the AGS platform, including the Saudi site and its SEO and analytics stack.
Designed and built 4longAge alone, from database schema to production server.
Joined a two-month-old company with no senior engineers and owned each system end to end: requirements, data model, API, frontend and deployment.
Built Dentecs, the Nakaba Central pension platform, OVACS, Geofence & TRACKi and the first version of the AGS platform.
Gathered requirements on site with clients, including days with the Engineers Syndicate's pensions department.
In progress, alongside full-time engineering work.
Taught myself Python from a downloaded course in third year.
Built a Flutter app as a fourth-year team project.
Graduation project: DIWAN, a Django document-archiving system for the university.

stack.title: Technical stack
stack.lead: What the nine systems above actually run on.

contact.title: Have a system to build?
contact.note: Open to remote roles and relocation. I work in Arabic and English from UTC+3, which overlaps with the Gulf and most of Europe.

seo.title: Ghaith Audi · Software engineer, backend first
seo.description: Ghaith Audi is a backend-first full-stack software engineer in Homs, Syria. Nine production systems: SaaS platforms, commerce sites, GPS tracking and enterprise integrations built with Django and Next.js.
